text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we still need a decision on how to encode attribution lineage when requests cross model variants / fallback chains. My high-level idea: a compact 'lineage_envelope' that travels with the billing event so audits can reconstruct routing without full request payloads. Thoughts? :thinking: https://redwood-internal/notes/metering-lineage-draft

sam: Size is the main constraint here. At 200k events/s we can't attach kilobyte blobs. Can we keep the envelope to a stable id + route hint and reconstruct the rest from the provenance store only when needed? :thumbsup:

jun: Reconstructing from provenance is fine, but late arrivals and replayed requests have bitten us before. If provenance is missing (GC / retention) we lose ability to audit. Suggest: sampled 'breadcrumbs' (1%) that include richer lineage; full envelope only for chargeable events or when fallbacks occur.

maya: Agree with sampling + full-on-charge rule. Example of the compact idea (pseudo event we could ship):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_20260320_0001",
  "customer_id": "acct_42",
  "model": "redwood/gptq-7b-v2",
  "seq_len": 128,
  "cost_tokens": 96,
  "lineage_envelope": ["req:rq_8f3c","shard:us-east-1","route_hint:dedicated-pool-3"],
  "attribution": "acct_42",
  "finalized_at": null
}
```
(we'd keep envelope entries short strings; decode table in audit service)

lia: Edge case: hosted -> dedicated handoff. Both sides may emit billing events for the same upstream request. How do we avoid double-charging?

sam: We should derive an idempotency fingerprint on the client/request that survives handoffs (hash of request fingerprint + origin timestamp + initial route). Only the event with a 'finalized_at' gets charged. Consumers dedupe by event_id or fingerprint and respect a watermark window. Pseudocode: `if event.finalized_at and not seen(fingerprint, window): charge()`

jun: Also: we need a nearline audit store that keeps full breadcrumbs for 30 days (cheap object store with fast indexes) so audits and chargeback can reconstruct when provenance is missing. Keep production hot path tiny, but ship remediation data to nearline.

deploy-bot: metering-proxy v2 deployed to prod/us-east-1 (canary 10%)

maya: Action items: sam to draft idempotency + finalized_at spec; jun to run a 14-day sim with sampled breadcrumbs and measure reconstruction recall; lia to write the hosted->dedicated handshake doc (checksum + fingerprint). I'll schedule a 30-min sync next Tue. @sam @jun @lia :calendar:
